Maya: FYI monitoring flagged node g2-rack12-slot3 with recurring Xid=31 after long idle. Short quick burn-in passed earlier; want to run an extended soak + mixed workload before returning to service.
Juan: What are the ECC counters and cadence of the Xid? any thermal spikes?
Maya: ECC corrected jumped from 18 -> 126 over ~48h. Temps steady 45-52°C. Kernel shows repeated:
`NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:05:00): 31` roughly every ~12h. Short burn-in didn't repro.
Omar: Could be intermittent PCIe link or a DMA/driver corner. Recommend long memtest + shader stress + periodic PCIe reset to try to reproduce.
Maya: Proposed harness: `soak-harness --workload=mixed --duration=48h --seed=3711 --pcie-reset-interval=300s --nvlink-stress --log-level=debug` collect `dmesg -T` and `nvidia-smi -q` every 60s.
Juan: Add `--powercycle-on-hang` and `--collect-bugreport-on-xid` flags. Also run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.total,memory.used,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv -l 10` in a sidecar.
triage-bot: Scheduled soak job gpu-soak-1910223344 on g2-rack12-slot3 starting 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z, duration 48h. Job ID: soak-1910223344.
sre-bot: Reminder: if you see Xid reappear capture full `nvidia-bug-report.sh` output and tag @platform-hw with timestamps and job ID. Also include `lspci -vvv` and `journalctl -k` slices.
Omar: If repro only with NVLink stress, isolate NVLink pair. If it follows the card across slots -> likely GPU/module defect. If it stops after powercycle -> flaky connection or seating.
Maya: Ran quick local `stress-ng --gpu 1 --timeout 10m` and `cuda_memtest` earlier, no repro. That's why we need a long mixed-seq soak.
Juan: After soak, swap card to spare slot and re-run same soak. Swap outcome is high-signal for slot vs card.
Maya: Starting soak now. Will post periodic 6h updates (metrics + top dmesg snippets). :thumbsup:
Maya: 6h update: no Xid yet. ECC corrected +12 since start. Attached dmesg snippet: `Mar 19 05:12:43 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:05:00): 31` -> (none so far).
Omar: Keep an eye on any PCIe AER logs (`/sys/kernel/debug/`), and capture `setpci` output for link width/speed. If pattern persists, open RMA ticket and include soak logs and bugreports.
Maya: Noted. If we hit Xid during soak I'll snapshot nvbug + full kernel log and mention @supply-chain for replacement flow.
